targeted_suite.command: python -m unittest test_redundancy_v10 test_raw_comparison test_metrics_report_v2 test_experience_ablation -q

validation_scope: Offline unit/integration tests including common-executor Python reads; not a SWE-bench outcome or detector accuracy study on real task traces.
limitations: Operational reusable-evidence redundancy, not complete semantic usefulness inference.
Local checks assume frozen workspace-local task dependencies; external or stochastic state is not fully observed.
Unsupported operations remain unknown and stay in the denominator; compare coverage between arms.
Legacy traces lack the new dependency evidence and cannot be relabelled as the new metric.
